inlines.v: WOMAN, noun plural women. [a compound of womb and man.] 1. The female of the human race, grown to adult years. And the rib, which the Lord god had taken from the man, made he a woman Genesis 2:22. Women are soft, mild, pitiful, and flexible. We see every day women perish with infamy, by having been too willing to set their beauty to show. I have observed among all nations that the women ornament themselves more tan the men; that wherever found, they are the same kind, civil, obliging, humane, tender beings, inclined to be gay and cheerful, timorous and modest. 2. A female attendant or servant. WOMAN, verb intransitive To make pliant.
